thread:
Maya (PM): Quick kickoff: NovaPay wants a 2-week private pilot in their VPC. Requirements: P95 <= 280ms, KMS or HSM for keys, audit logs, and automatic fallback to hosted. Need cross-team sequencing and owner. Who's in?
Kevin (Eng-runtime): Happy to lead runtime validation. Need the prompt corpus and model size. Also suggest a 10m prewarm and a 5m idle-shed policy.
Nora (Solutions): I'll get the sample prompts + expected percentiles of token lengths from NovaPay. They said average 256 in / 512 out but have heavy tails.
Anika (Infra): Infra can stand up a dedicated pool in the region. Need committed time windows and expected qps. Also: will we use dedicated subnets or shared peering?
Sam (Product Ops): Customer baseline qps=40, burst up to 150. Pilot should start at baseline with canary to 100 over 48h. They want a SLA trial: target availability 99.5% for pilot.
Leo (Security): HSM onboarding for customer managed keys is ~3-4w. Cloud KMS ok for the short pilot if legal signs off. We need redaction rules and 7-day audit retention at minimum.
Maya (PM): Proposal: use cloud KMS for pilot, collect audit logs 30d, and plan HSM for post-pilot if they convert. Confirmed?
Leo (Security): OK from my side pending legal note. I'll draft minimal checklist: key rotation policy, access list, redaction owner.
Kevin (Eng-runtime): Runtime tasks:
- ship 4-bit quant variant + fp16 fallback
- enable KV prefix cache for repeated prompts
- add route-level batch/window tunables
Estimate: 4 dev-days + 2 perf-days. Also need perf harness.
Anika (Infra): Infra tasks:
- provision 12 GPUs initially (estimate)
- VPC peering, route tables, KMS setup
- console log retention pipeline
Estimate: 8 infra-days to be ready, plus networking sign-off.
Nora (Solutions): Adding that NovaPay expects median response times to be <150ms; P95 is the big ask. I'll push them for a small seed set of worst-case prompts for early perf.
Kevin (Eng-runtime): Quick back-of-envelope calc I ran locally:
```
qps = 40
avg_tokens = 768  # 256 in + 512 out
tokens_per_second = qps * avg_tokens
gpu_throughput = 2200  # tokens/sec per GPU with int4 + batching
gpus_needed = ceil(tokens_per_second / gpu_throughput)
```
That lands ~14 GPUs; with prefix cache we might get down to ~9. We'll tune after perf runs.
Anika (Infra): I'll provision a 12-GPU pool as a middle ground, err on safe side. If runtime shows fewer needed we can scale down. Need cost estimate for customer facing doc.
Sam (Product Ops): Rollback metrics we propose: P95 > 320ms OR error rate > 1% sustained for 5m. Also define success: sustained P95 <= 280ms for 24h at baseline qps.
Maya (PM): Action items:
- Nora: get prompt corpus and worst-case list (EOD tomorrow).
- Kevin: perf runs + canary config (3bd).
- Anika: draft infra sizing + peering checklist + cost ballpark (5bd).
- Leo: minimal security checklist and KMS note (3bd).
- Sam: contract addendum w/ pilot SLA + fallback clause (5bd).
@deploy-bot can you open a ticket and link owners?
deploy-bot: Created ticket NP-601: "novapay-private-pilot-orbit" and added template.
Kevin (Eng-runtime): I'll need a short model freeze window during canary, probably 2h. Flagging now so teams can coordinate.
Anika (Infra): I scheduled a 20m network sync tomorrow 11:00 to run CIDR + peering details. Invite sent to the thread.
Maya (PM): OK setting daily stand at 09:30 next week during pilot. Will update roadmap entry and mark dependencies. Thanks all :rocket:
Kevin (Eng-runtime): Ack.
Leo (Security): Ack, will share checklist draft in 2 days.
Nora (Solutions): On it, will push the prompt set today.
Sam (Product Ops): Looping legal now.
Maya (PM): Keeping thread open for updates.
